description: This Java source file defines the WorkEffortWorker class, which provides utility methods for managing and querying work effort entities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods to retrieve lowest level work efforts in a hierarchy, remove duplicates from a list, and handles entity queries and associations related to work efforts.

classes.name: WorkEffortWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for querying and processing work effort entities, including retrieving hierarchical relationships and removing duplicates.

methods.name: getLowestLevelWorkEfforts
methods.description: Retrieves the list of lowest-level work efforts related to a specified work effort, based on association type and optionally specified entity field names.

methods.name: removeDuplicateWorkEfforts
methods.description: Removes duplicate work effort entries from a list based on their workEffortId.
